components.caption: Dispatches an action. `primary` is the filled button.

variants.caption: The default variant: an outlined button.
A text button, for the least emphasis.
A button whose child is an Icon rather than Text.
variants.noReference: Icon-only child; the kit's Button always carries a label.

components.caption: A container for one child, here the kit card's full set of slots. Drawn as an outlined card.
Titled tabs over one child each. The first tab is selected.
A trigger that opens its content in a dialog.
components.noReference: At rest a Modal draws only its trigger; the dialog it opens (a BasicAlertDialog) is not shown until the trigger is pressed, so there is no resting picture to compare to the kit.

components.caption: A run of text in one of seven roles. `body` by default.
components.noReference: The M3 kit publishes type STYLES, not a Text component; the roles each variant maps to are the Material type scale.

components.caption: One of the catalog's named glyphs.
components.noReference: The glyph set is the catalog's own (`material3-a2ui` bundles its 60 icons); the M3 kit's Icons page is a glyph library, not a component to compare against.

components.caption: A hairline between groups of content.

variants.caption: A vertical rule between two items in a row.
variants.noReference: Drawn between two labels in a row; the kit node is the bare rule.

components.caption: A labelled text input bound to the data model. `shortText` by default.
A labelled boolean bound to the data model.
Pick from a list of options. Chips, allowing several selections.

variants.caption: An exposed dropdown summarising the selection; the options open in a menu.
variants.noReference: Exposed dropdown anchored on an outlined text field; no single kit node.

components.caption: A labelled value between `min` and `max`, bound to the data model.
A date and time, shown as a chip that opens the Material pickers.
Children side by side. `justify` spreads them along the row, `align` across it.
components.noReference: A2UI layout primitive drawn with foundation's Row; the M3 kit publishes no layout component.

components.caption: Children stacked vertically. `align: start` keeps each child at its own width.
components.noReference: A2UI layout primitive drawn with foundation's Column; the M3 kit publishes no layout component.

components.caption: A scrolling run of children. Vertical by default.
components.noReference: A2UI scrolling container drawn with foundation's lazy lists; the M3 kit's `List` is a list ITEM with leading and trailing slots, which A2UI does not publish.

components.caption: An image at one of six catalog sizes. `mediumFeature` by default: 128dp, 12dp corners.
components.noReference: The picture is the app's renderer; the kit publishes no image component.

components.caption: A video, shown at rest as its poster frame.
components.noReference: The player is the app's renderer; the kit publishes no video component.

components.caption: An audio track with its description, at rest.
components.noReference: The player is the app's renderer; the kit publishes no audio component.
